features: Road-facing 1080P camera (3.2mm lens, 104° horizontal) integrated with the host
ADAS: lane departure, pedestrian collision, safe distance and forward collision warnings
DSM: yawning, smoking, distraction, closing-eyes and phone-call detection
Emergency alarm button; low voltage protection
notes: Product page states up to 4 video inputs (3CH AHD + 1CH IPC). The manual states up to 3 AHD inputs, and only 2 channels when ADAS/DSM is enabled.
Highest stated recording resolution is 1080P; no megapixel figure is stated.
TF card capacity: product page states 512G per slot, manual 256GB per card. Capacity left out.
Alarm inputs: 3 IO inputs, one used by the emergency alarm button.
Audio input stated as a built-in 1-channel MIC supporting up to 2-channel audio input; audio output is a built-in 1-way speaker (8Ω1W).
USB: 1x Mini USB 2.0 for data export and maintenance.
